Name: global AGENTS.md
Purpose: Global preferences and working habits applied across all projects

Name: project-specific AGENTS.md
Purpose: Specific custom project context and instructions auto-loaded at the start of each session

Name: deep-research
Purpose: Agent team for literature search verification synthesis and systematic review

Name: r-style-guide
Purpose: Conventions for writing R, e.g. naming, spacing, layout, function design

Name: tidyverse-patterns
Purpose: Conventions for using tidyverse packages, e.g. modern pipes, joins, grouping, string handling

Name: quarto-authoring
Purpose: Authoring with Quarto documents, e.g. cross-references, citations, and extensions

Name: zotero-cli
Purpose: Searches, reads, and annotates the author's Zotero library from the shell

Name: paperdoctor
Purpose: Suite of skills that reviews a manuscript in progress by checking its claims, code, math, references and visual layout, then renders every finding into one interactive HTML report

Name: open-scholar-skill
Purpose: Suite of skills for assisting with social science research through a pipeline of verification gates, e.g. idea generation, theory exploration, study design, analysis, ethics, etc

Name: manuscript-writing-review
Purpose: Reviews a scientific or engineering manuscript for writing quality, e.g. clutter, passive voice, sentence architecture, keyword consistency, and numerical or citation errors

Name: r-mcptools
Purpose: Exposes a running R session so the agent can execute code and read results

Name: refcheck
Purpose: Searches publication databases and returns verified references with BibTeX

Name: scholar_mcp
Purpose: Searches Google Scholar and other sources by keywords and then reads inside papers

Name: markitdown
Purpose: Converts DOCX files, PDFs and web pages to markdown the agent can read

Name: open-scholar-peer
Purpose: An open source implementation of ScholarPeer: A Context-Aware Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Peer Review

Name: playwright
Purpose: Provides browser automation capabilities for LLMs, allowing AI agents to interact with web pages
